command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

echo "== a TRUE sequence, a draft with a known number of planted errors, reads from the truth =="
awk 'function r(n,  s,i){ s=""; for(i=0;i<n;i++) s=s substr(B,int(rand()*4)+1,1); return s }
function other(c,  m){ m="ACGT"; return substr(m, (index(m,c) % 4) + 1, 1) }
BEGIN{ srand(89); B="ACGT"
  T = r(10000)
  printf ">truth\n%s\n", T > "truth.fa"
  D = T; nsub=0
  for (p=200; p<=8000; p+=400) { D = substr(D,1,p-1) other(substr(D,p,1)) substr(D,p+1); nsub++ }
  ndel=0; split("9000 9300 9600", dl, " ")
  for (i=3; i>=1; i--) { p=dl[i]+0; D = substr(D,1,p-1) substr(D,p+1); ndel++ }
  printf ">draft\n%s\n", D > "draft.fa"
  printf "planted_substitutions\t%d\nplanted_deletions\t%d\ntruth_len\t%d\ndraft_len\t%d\n",
    nsub, ndel, length(T), length(D) > "truth.tsv"
}'
cat truth.tsv
TL=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="truth_len"{print $2}' truth.tsv)
DL=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="draft_len"{print $2}' truth.tsv)
test "$TL" = "10000" || { echo "truth is $TL bp"; exit 1; }
test $(( TL - DL )) = 3 || { echo "draft/truth length difference is not the 3 planted deletions"; exit 1; }

echo "== the draft must actually differ from the truth (a fixture that plants nothing proves nothing) =="
awk '!/^>/{printf "%s", $0} END{print ""}' truth.fa > t.seq
awk '!/^>/{printf "%s", $0} END{print ""}' draft.fa > d.seq
cmp -s t.seq d.seq && { echo "draft is identical to truth -- nothing to polish"; exit 1; }
echo "draft != truth, as planted"

echo "== reads from the TRUTH: this is the evidence the polisher gets =="
awk 'BEGIN{
  while ((getline l < "truth.fa") > 0) if (l !~ /^>/) T = T l
  RL=1000; q=""; for(i=0;i<RL;i++) q=q "I"
  starts=length(T)-RL+1; n=0
  for(p=1; p<=starts; p+=33){ n++; printf "@rd%d\n%s\n+\n%s\n", n, substr(T,p,RL), q > "reads.fq" }
  printf "reads\t%d\ncoverage\t%.1fx\n", n, n*RL/length(T)
}' | tee -a truth.tsv

echo "== align the reads to the DRAFT =="
minimap2 --version
minimap2 -x map-ont -t 2 draft.fa reads.fq > ov.paf 2> mm.log
NPAF=$(awk 'END{print NR+0}' ov.paf)
NRD=$(awk 'END{print NR/4}' reads.fq)
test "$NPAF" -ge "$NRD" || { echo "only $NPAF alignments for $NRD reads"; exit 1; }
{ printf 'minimap2_version\t%s\n' "$(minimap2 --version)"
  printf 'paf_alignments\t%s for %s reads\n' "$NPAF" "$NRD"; } | tee fixture.txt
echo "ALIGN OK"
